outputs.explanation: Panel A consists solely of fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker Deep Red, Merge) with no plotted summary statistics; the individual-data-points check does not apply.

In addition to the micrographs, panel B includes two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) that show only mean bars with error bars; no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel C is a western blot image with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.

Panel D includes histochemical micrographs plus two bar charts (SDH and COX signal intensity) with error bars and sample sizes noted (e.g., n=15, n=23/26); no individual data points are shown for these means.

Panel E's plots are FACS histograms (cell count vs. TMRM intensity) depicting full distributions across replicates, not bar charts of averages; such distribution/line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
